verdict.rationale: Orama is a search platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. First-party docs state every Orama Cloud project comes with an auto-configured MCP server for its data, usable from ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI interfaces, and probes confirm a dedicated MCP Server docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, details on exposed tools/auth/setup, and any MCP server for the open-source Orama library (evidence covers Cloud only).
